output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows the owner to increase the balance of any user, causing a devaluation of the token.
The _transfer function does not check for overflow, allowing users to transfer more tokens than they own.
The burnFrom function allows the owner to burn any user's tokens, making them irretrievable.
The buy function has an integer overflow, allowing users to buy an unintended amount of tokens.
The sell function has an integer overflow, allowing users to sell an unintended amount of tokens.
